investment_strategy: Core-satellite AI exposure. Anchor the portfolio in a lower-volatility AI platform leader (Microsoft) and overweight a high-growth, high-momentum AI beneficiary (Alphabet) to capture diffusion of generative AI across consumer and enterprise. Add a small satellite position in a U.S. onshoring semiconductor supplier (Microchip Technology) to benefit from capacity buildout and supply-chain reshaping. This balances structural AI growth with risk management amid regulatory scrutiny and semiconductor geopolitics.

final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Strong recent growth and fastest momentum among peers justify the largest weight to capture upside from rapid AI integration across services; risk balanced by diversification and a lower-volatility anchor.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI platform leaders with semiconductor onshoring tailwinds; core-satellite construction to balance growth and volatility

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility anchor + strong growth + fast momentum, filtered by supportive news sentiment and alignment with AI diffusion and chip onshoring trends; excluded names with declining growth or bearish momentum without offsetting catalysts.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive long-term given generative AI adoption and chip capacity buildout; expect bouts of volatility from regulatory actions, export controls, and sensitivity to rising AI capex. Portfolio tilts to durable AI monetization and policy-supported semiconductors.
